title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet, Solid Brass | Flat Troll Blue | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bath towels within reach without drilling into walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet creates instant hanging space right where you need it in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stay steady on the floor with a large weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Built for enduring use with solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion.
  • Coordinate matching pieces with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 10.5 in.
  • Shipping weight: 17 lbs
  • Some assembly required
  • Limited lifetime warranty
  • Made in the USA
